Riz Pass details

Riz Pass is an auto-renewing weekly subscription billed to your Google Play account. The price and billing period are shown in the app and in Google Play before you buy. It renews automatically at the end of each period until you cancel; cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date to avoid the next charge. To cancel, open Google Play > Profile > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions > Riz Pass, Deleting the app does not cancel it. Cancelling stops future renewals; access continues until the end of the paid period. Refunds are handled by Google Play under its refund policy. If a free trial or introductory offer is shown at purchase, it applies to new subscribers only.

Coins, hints and other virtual items

Coins, leaves, hints and similar items are virtual items with no cash value. They cannot be exchanged for money or transferred, and they are lost if you delete your data or uninstall the game. Prizes from the daily spin and the day-7 chest are free daily rewards; they are never bought with money. Purchased coin packs and other one-time items are consumed or unlocked in the game and are not refundable by us except as Google Play's policy or the law requires.
